article: Using data to strengthen and future-proof your compliance strategy
stem: A multinational company faces a compliance dashboard showing stable completion rates while exceptions continue to rise. Which action should its chief compliance officer prioritize to improve monitoring effectiveness?

Test whether controls work in practice, investigate anomalies, and use findings to adjust monitoring and remediation.
